description: Generate and schedule persona videos from complete scripts: one video, or a batch of 2-12 (every 6 videos with the persona face, the cheapest is free; voiceover videos pay full price and are never free; all videos are created within 10 minutes). Charges prepaid tokens. mode 'scheduled' slots a video 3h-30d ahead (startAt and times); 'asap' publishes it when generation finishes. Give persona and accounts by name or id: they are resolved here, and an unknown or ambiguous name creates nothing. Omit accounts to publish to the persona's bound accounts. The result echoes what was resolved. Then follow the videos with video_tasks (action: status). For a video about a topic (news, a place, a product, GitHub PRs) call prompts (action: list) first and follow the matching recipe with prompts (action: get); validate every script with check_script (action: validate) before spending tokens. When the script was written from a prompt, pass that prompt's versionId as promptVersionId on each video: experiments (action: results) compares prompts by it. Pacing is an experiment, not a guess: vary one knob at a time — videoClipDuration, videoTransitionMode or videoVariationSeed — across videos of the same niche and compare their results; the best pacing for a niche is learned from those comparisons, not assumed upfront. Caption placement is options.subtitlePosition (top, center, bottom, custom with options.subtitleCustomPosition): top keeps the caption clear of the face. An optional on-screen headline is options.hookTitle (at most 7 words and 60 characters): it shows at the top for the first 3 seconds, captions move below it meanwhile; validate it with check_script (action: validate, hookTitle) before spending tokens. When A/B testing a knob, change one knob at a time, in the same niche, and compare before changing another.

batchKey.description: Required with 2+ videos, rejected with one. A name unique per batch; reuse it with the same videos in the same order to retry (created videos replay, no second charge).

idempotencyKey.description: One video only: retrying with the same key returns the original schedule (replayed: true).

recipe.description: The recipe slug (from prompts (action: list) / prompts (action: get)) this script was written with. Omit when the script was not written from a recipe.

videos.description: The videos: one is generated and scheduled right away, 2-12 are a batch.

accounts.description: Accounts to publish to, each an account name or id from accounts (the network is read from the account). Omit for the persona's bound publishing accounts.

description.description: Video description: the publish copy sent to the web route (one call is one video). Required — there is no fallback to the title.

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US.

mode.description: Publish mode: 'scheduled' (default) slots the video across startAt + times; 'asap' publishes it the moment generation finishes, with no scheduled time — do not set startAt or times.

options.description: Generation options applied to this video.

audioUrl.description: Public URL of custom audio for the videos (overrides the persona voice).

hookPanel.description: hook_lipsync only: false keeps the face alone during the hook (no photo panel under it). Omitted uses the persona default; rejected for other video types.

hookTitle.description: Optional on-screen headline shown at the top of the video for its first 3 seconds (less when the first segment is shorter), above any photos: at most 7 words and 60 characters, no newline or control character. Punctuation and case are kept as written. The engine sets it in at most two lines and moves the captions below it while it shows. A title that does not fit is left out and reported as a media warning; a title over the limits is refused with a stable HOOK_TITLE_* code before any token is charged.

imageId.description: Library image ID to pin for every video (overrides the deterministic per-video selection; see persona_media (action: list_images)). The pinned photo is only used for the lip-sync-active check and is never rendered in the video.

language.description: Spoken language code — English only for now, e.g. en-US. Overrides the persona when one is given.

lipsyncPhotos.description: full_lipsync only, and required there: 2-5 different face photos of the persona, all the same person (other outfits, places or angles), so the video does not stay on one photo. The narration is cut into windows of at most 12s and window i shows photo i (photo i % count when there are fewer photos than windows): send one photo per 12s of narration, e.g. 2 for a 24s video, 4 for 48s, 5 for 60s. Each item is mediaId (from media (action: upload), a temporary asset, 1 hour) or url (a public image URL). Every photo must show a detectable face and no photo may repeat. Rejected for hook_lipsync and voiceover.

musicMood.description: Background-music mood for the video: a mood from the engine BGM catalog, or "none" for explicit no music. Omitted lets the engine pick the first catalogued mood; an unknown mood is rejected with a 400 naming the valid moods. Works with voiceover videos too.

niche.description: Content niche. Overrides the persona when one is given.

paragraphNumber.description: Paragraph count (1-10). Overrides the persona when one is given.

subtitleCustomPosition.description: Caption height as percent from the top (0-100). Only with subtitlePosition "custom"; rejected otherwise.

subtitlePosition.description: Caption placement: top keeps the caption near the top of the frame, clear of the face and the lower photo area; center is the default; bottom sits near the bottom; custom places it at subtitleCustomPosition percent from the top. A/B rule: change one knob at a time, in the same niche, and compare before changing another.

videoAspect.description: Frame shape. Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to 9:16.

videoClipDuration.description: Pacing weight, not exact seconds: maximum seconds per photo (1-60). Omitted keeps the 2s default. The engine fits photo holds to the real spoken audio, stretching each photo at most 1.5x its pace, so a larger value means slower holds and fewer photos, not a longer video. A/B test it: change one knob at a time between videos of the same niche and compare their results.

videoLayout.description: How the persona hook is composed with the video material (the agent images). Overrides the persona when one is given; a post without a persona defaults to "standard". Same render cost either way.

videoTransitionMode.description: Transition between clips: Shuffle varies it per clip, Crossfade blends segment photos over 0.5s, FadeIn/FadeOut fade each clip in/out, SlideIn/SlideOut slide it in/out. Omitted keeps hard cuts. A/B test it like videoClipDuration: one knob at a time, same niche, and compare results.

videoType.description: The one video mode: full_lipsync = the whole video is the persona talking (requires a persona with a photo and options.lipsyncPhotos; 8 tokens at face quality ok, 15 at very_good); hook_lipsync = lip sync on the hook only, agent images after (requires a persona with a photo, and a first photo in the segments — the hook photo; the persona's saved photo is never shown in the video; 2 tokens ok, 3 very_good); voiceover = the persona voice over the agent images, no lip sync and no persona on camera; the images may show people (persona optional — with one, its voice and niche still apply; 1 token). Required: the mode decides the render path and the price.

videoVariationSeed.description: Seed for per-video variation of the segment photos zoom direction; the same seed repeats the same pattern. Omitted keeps the fixed in/out alternation. Change it for a different look of the same script without changing pacing.

voiceId.description: Voice ID override: id or label from voices (action: list). Never type a provider prefix.

webhookUrl.description: Callback URL the server POSTs to when each video reaches a terminal state (completed/failed).

persona.description: The persona, by name or id. Omit for a voiceover post with no persona: then set options.videoType to 'voiceover' and options.voiceId (or options.audioUrl).

pinterestBoardId.description: Pinterest only: the board to publish the pin to (the id from accounts (action: list_boards)). Required when pinterest is selected.

promptVersionId.description: The versionId that prompts (action: get) returned for the prompt this script was written from. The video records it, and experiments (action: results) compares videos by prompt version. Omit when the script was not written from a prompt.

providers.description: Networks to publish to. Omit to use the networks of `accounts`, or of the persona's bound publishing accounts when `accounts` is omitted too.

segments.description: The complete script as segments (takes): first hook, then content takes in order. Total 60-200 words, content at least 30, hook 25-40 words before TTS. The hook must end with terminal punctuation. A CTA is just a content take, placed anywhere. No LLM expands this script.

kind.description: Segment role: hook first, content after. Exactly one hook; a CTA is just a content take, placed anywhere.

media.description: Photos for this segment. Each item is mediaId (from media (action: upload)) or url (a public image URL). One image per ~2s of speech (~5-6 words); a 60s video needs ~30 images, split across segments (max 30). Full lip sync: max 6 images total, shown as panels over the face (the face photos themselves go in options.lipsyncPhotos). Optional duration (0.5-6s): the relative pace of a full-frame photo; omit for the 2s default. The render shares the real spoken time of each segment among its photos in proportion to their durations (a 5s photo holds 2.5x a 2s one), so durations never need to match the voice exactly: a shorter voice compresses them and a longer one stretches them up to 1.5x. Optional overlay: an info card (title, subtitle, badge), e.g. a place name, address and price; a spoken caption sits above it, never on the photo.

badge.description: Short highlight such as a price or a year, shown as a pill above the title.

subtitle.description: Address or area, shown under the title.

title.description: The real place name, shown large on the card.

text.description: Spoken text only: no placeholders, links, markdown, emoji or stage directions.

startAt.description: When the publish slot may start: ISO datetime. Required unless mode is 'asap'. The slot must be 3h-30d ahead.

times.description: Daily publish times in HH:MM 24-hour format. Required unless mode is 'asap'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a naive startAt and the HH:MM times, e.g. "Europe/Lisbon". Defaults to UTC.

title.description: Video title: the slot label sent to the web route (one call is one video).

name: generate_video
